evaluation: exploratory offline replay on previously used 120-card sample
deployment_rule: Only the complete policy is eligible for runtime activation; require at least one saved call and no observed loss of precision, recall or F1 against replayed hybrid. Partial policies are diagnostic only.
latency: Reconstructed from current local replay time plus original saved gateway call durations; no new network latency measurement.
data: data/benchmarks/release-v1; gold is only used by the evaluator after routing.
